papers.title_in_file: Redefining Randomness: Quantis QRNG PCIe-40M & PCIe-240M (Product Brochure)
papers.what_it_is: A two-page ID Quantique product brochure, dated April 2021, for the Quantis PCIe-40M and PCIe-240M quantum random number generator cards.

assertions.value: The vendor states that the Quantis PCIe-40M and PCIe-240M embed IDQ20MC1 chips, which generate randomness from the shot noise of a light source captured by a CMOS image sensor.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, Provably secure
quotes: Quantis PCIe-40M and PCIe-240M embed IDQ20MC1 chips
generate randomness from the shot noise of a light source captured by a CMOS image sensor
assertions.reader_inference: A brochure description of the product's entropy source; no design detail, entropy model or measurement is given.

assertions.value: The vendor states that the cards can generate random bits directly from the entropy source (entropy data mode), or after NIST compliant post-processing (RNG data mode).
assertions.anchor: Page 1, Provably secure
quotes: They can generate random bits directly from the entropy source (entropy data mode), or after a NIST compliant post-processing (RNG data mode).

assertions.value: The vendor's table lists the PCIe-40M with a quantum entropy source rate of 38.3 Mbps plus or minus 5% and an RNG data output (embedded NIST compliant DRBG) of 9.6 Mbps plus or minus 5%.
assertions.anchor: Page 2 (table 'Quantis QRNG modules at a glance'), PERFORMANCE
quotes: RNG Data Output (embedded NIST compliant DRBG)
assertions.reader_inference: Column assignment (first value to PCIe-40M, second to PCIe-240M) follows the order of the text layer; the table header lists PCIe-40M first. The RNG output is about a quarter of the raw entropy rate on both models. The brochure gives no measurement conditions.

assertions.value: The vendor's table lists the PCIe-240M with a quantum entropy source rate of 232 Mbps plus or minus 5% and an RNG data output (embedded NIST compliant DRBG) of 58 Mbps plus or minus 5%.
assertions.anchor: Page 2 (table 'Quantis QRNG modules at a glance'), PERFORMANCE
quotes: RNG Data Output (embedded NIST compliant DRBG)
assertions.reader_inference: Column assignment follows the order of the text layer; PCIe-240M is the second column. The brochure gives no measurement conditions.

assertions.value: The vendor states that the new PCIe-40M and PCIe-240M are compliant with NIST SP800 90A/B/C recommendations and pass IID, non-IID tests, DieHarder and NIST SP800-22 test suites.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, Compliant and certified
quotes: are compliant with NIST SP800 90A/B/C recommendations and passes IID, non-IID tests, DieHarder and NIST SP800-22 test suites
assertions.reader_inference: The brochure reports no test output, p-values, entropy estimates or lab name, so the compliance statement cannot be checked from this document.

assertions.value: The vendor's table marks NIST SP800-90A/B/C, SP800-22 and DieHarder test suite compliance as supported for both models.
assertions.anchor: Page 2 (table 'Quantis QRNG modules at a glance'), CERTIFICATIONS
quotes: NIST SP800-90A/B/C, SP800-22 and DieHarder test suite compliance
assertions.reader_inference: The check marks are glyphs that the text layer prints as a single character per cell; both model columns carry one.

assertions.value: The vendor states that METAS and CC certifications of the two new products are under way, and the table lists BSI Common Criteria and AIS 31 certification as pending for both models.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, Compliant and certified; Page 2 (table 'Quantis QRNG modules at a glance'), CERTIFICATIONS
quotes: METAS and CC certifications of these two new products are under way.
assertions.reader_inference: As of the April 2021 specification date, neither card holds a third-party certification according to this document.

assertions.value: The vendor states that legacy Quantis PCIe and USB products have been certified by leading commercial entities, well-known international institutes and governments worldwide, and that they also present an AIS31 version compliant with the German BSI's AIS31 validation criteria.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, Compliant and certified
quotes: Legacy Quantis PCIe and USB have been certified by leading commercial entities, well-known international institutes and governments worldwide.
Legacy PCIe and USB also present an AIS31 version that is compliant with the German BSI
assertions.reader_inference: No certificate numbers or issuing bodies are named.

assertions.value: The vendor states that live status verification and entropy source health monitoring performed at chip level ensure the cards always provide the highest entropy, and that any failure or attacks are detected.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, Provably secure
quotes: Live status verification and entropy source health monitoring performed at chip level ensure the PCie cards always provide the highest entropy, and any failure or attacks are detected.
assertions.reader_inference: The brochure names no health tests, thresholds or attack model; 'any ... attacks are detected' is an unquantified claim.

assertions.value: The vendor states that only Quantum Random Number Generators (QRNGs) are intrinsically random and provably unpredictable.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, subtitle
quotes: Only Quantum Random Number Generators (QRNGs) are intrinsically random and provably unpredictable
assertions.reader_inference: A marketing statement with no proof or reference in the brochure. It is stronger than the usual physics position, where the guarantee of a real device depends on how well the device is modelled and on its noise and classical contributions.

assertions.value: The vendor describes the Quantis family as exploiting elementary quantum optic processes that are fundamentally probabilistic to produce true randomness, and lists a provably secure source of entropy as a reason to choose Quantis QRNGs.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, Provably secure; page 2, Why choose Quantis QRNGs?
quotes: The Quantis QRNG family exploits elementary quantum optic processes that are fundamentally probabilistic to produce true randomness.
assertions.reader_inference: The brochure gives no security proof or security definition; 'provably secure' is not backed in this document.

assertions.value: The vendor states that the quantum processes underlying the QRNG are well understood and characterized, so their inner working can be modelled and controlled to produce the highest entropy from the first bit.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, Provably secure
quotes: As the quantum processes underlying the QRNG are well understood and characterized, their inner working can be clearly modelized and controlled to produce the highest entropy from the first bit.

assertions.value: The vendor's table gives the thermal noise contribution as below 1%, defined as the fraction of random bits arising from thermal noise.
assertions.anchor: Page 2 (table 'Quantis QRNG modules at a glance'), ENVIRONMENTAL
quotes: <1% (fraction of random bits arising from thermal noise)
assertions.reader_inference: This implies that a small share of output bits is classical in origin, which the headline statement of intrinsic randomness does not mention. The brochure does not say how the figure was measured.

assertions.value: The vendor's table gives a storage temperature range of -40 °C to +85 °C and an operating temperature range of 0 °C to +50 °C for both models.
assertions.anchor: Page 2 (table 'Quantis QRNG modules at a glance'), ENVIRONMENTAL

assertions.value: The vendor's table gives the card dimensions as 80 x 63.75 mm for both models, and the specification as PCI Express Base 1.0a compliant.
assertions.anchor: Page 2 (table 'Quantis QRNG modules at a glance'), PHYSICAL CHARACTERISTICS

assertions.value: The vendor's table lists support of the Quantis library and EasyQuantis application on Windows 10 and Ubuntu 18.04 for both models.
assertions.anchor: Page 2 (table 'Quantis QRNG modules at a glance'), OS SUPPORTED
quotes: OS SUPPORTED (QUANTIS LIBRARY AND EASYQUANTIS APPLICATION)*

assertions.value: The vendor states that the Quantis library produces random binary data, integers and floating point numbers, can access multiple Quantis generators, and includes random data scaling; that the Quantis extensions libraries implement a randomness extractor for post-processing the output; and that the Easy Quantis application reads and displays random numbers or stores them in a file.
assertions.anchor: Page 2 (table 'Quantis QRNG modules at a glance'), footnote (*)
quotes: Quantis library enables the production of random binary data, integers and floating point numbers.
The Quantis extensions libraries implement a randomness extractor which can be used to postprocess the output of the Quantis QRNG.
Easy Quantis application allow to read and display random numbers or store them in a file.

assertions.value: The vendor states that the Quantis QRNG family has been commonly used since 2001 as a trusted source of randomness, for key generation for cryptographic modules, access protection for networks, servers, virtual machines and applications, data integrity and confidentiality, gaming, and scientific simulations or modeling.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, introduction
quotes: Since 2001, the Quantis QRNG family is commonly used as trusted source of randomness for multiple applications
assertions.reader_inference: No customer, deployment count or audit is given.

assertions.value: The vendor's applications list names Artificial Intelligence (Machine and Deep Learning) as one application area, alongside confidentiality and integrity of sensitive data, security of end-consumer devices, scientific modeling and simulations, financial transactions and blockchain, and gaming and random drawings.
assertions.anchor: Page 1, Applications
assertions.reader_inference: Only a list entry; the brochure gives no description of how the random bits would be used in ML or any result.

assertions.value: The vendor states that its information and specifications are subject to change at any time without prior notice, and dates the specifications as of April 2021.
assertions.anchor: Page 2, Disclaimer
quotes: The information and specification set forth in this document are subject to change at any time by ID Quantique without prior notice.
assertions.certainty_reason: The document's own disclaimer states the date and the scope of its specifications.
assertions.reader_inference: Every figure above is a vendor figure as of April 2021 and may have changed.
